paper.abstract_en: We establish rigidity theorems for cosmological spacetimes in $3$ spacetime dimensions. In the setting of the Bartnik Splitting Conjecture, under the additional assumptions of null geodesic completeness and the dominant energy condition, we show that the spatial topology is either spherical or the spacetime splits as a product. Our methods rely on the theory of marginally outer trapped surfaces, known rigidity results in the presence of a timelike or null line, and more recent rigidity results in the context of Penrose's singularity theorem due to the first two authors, from which the existence of a foliation by totally geodesic null hypersurfaces can be concluded. Our second main result closes the argument by establishing a splitting theorem for cosmological and null geodesically complete $3$-dimensional spacetimes which satisfy the dominant energy condition and which admit a foliation of the aforementioned type. In its proof, we make use of the local Kundt structure of the metric and construct a global parallel generator for the null foliation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在3维宇宙学时空的Bartnik分裂猜想框架下证明刚性定理，结合零测地完备性、主能量条件、边缘外陷获面理论与Penrose奇点定理的刚性结果，并证明分裂定理；属于广义相对论基础中的时空整体结构问题，理论深度较高，选题具体且论证链条清晰，值得点开进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在3个时空维度中为宇宙学时空建立刚性定理。在Bartnik分裂猜想的设定下，在额外假设零测地完备性与主能量条件的情况下，我们证明空间拓扑要么是球形的，要么时空分解为乘积。我们的方法依赖于边缘外陷获面理论、在存在类时或零线情况下的已知刚性结果，以及前两位作者在Penrose奇点定理背景下较新的刚性结果，由此可以得出存在由全测地零超曲面构成的叶状结构。我们的第二个主要结果通过为满足主能量条件且容许上述类型叶状结构的宇宙学且零测地完备的3维时空建立分裂定理，完成了论证。在其证明中，我们利用了度规的局部Kundt结构，并为零叶状结构构造了一个整体平行生成元。
